title: Betty and Barney Hill abduction possibly done by humans

tellings.quote: Well, I I it very likely was, but only because the mechanism how it happened would not be consistent with interstellar transdimensional technologies.

related.note: Both are about the same 1961 Betty and Barney Hill abduction. Greer offers a competing explanation, that humans did it rather than non-humans.

plain: Betty and Barney Hill were a New Hampshire couple who said they were abducted in 1961, and a researcher named Steven Greer tells Michels the abduction was very likely carried out by humans, not by visitors from elsewhere. He reasons that the way it happened does not fit what he calls interstellar, transdimensional technology, and he cites no source for that. If he is right, one of the best-known abduction stories would have been a human operation dressed up to look alien.
